reviewCadence: Monthly and after an evidence-integrity incident

required: exactly one assessment for every approved goal version
exactly one assessment for every approved success check
immutable commit and blob coordinates for every supported or partial claim
explicit unsupported or unverified status when evidence is absent or cannot be verified
unique ranked recommendations bound to approved goals and immutable evidence
block: supported or partial claims without bindable immutable evidence
source text or source-derived narrative that fails redaction
coordinates that do not resolve in the analyzed commit
